name: Invoice Approval Tool Use Carlos
description: Only the Lab 10 Maestro process InvoiceApprovalProcess_Carlos may invoke the approval agent Invoice_Approval_Agent_Carlos and the RPA process PostToERP_Carlos (both in Agentic Bootcamp/APAutomation_Carlos) as tools. Any other caller (another Maestro process, an agent, a Flow or a case) gets no Allow from this policy and falls to the default Deny. The policy places no limit on which user or robot runs the caller. The POMatch_Carlos functions are not covered, because ToolUsePolicy has no Function resource type. Draft: the caller key is a placeholder until Lab 10 creates the process.
